name: Cost of living
positive_means: Lowers everyday costs (groceries, childcare, general prices)
negative_means: Raises everyday costs

name: Personal taxes
positive_means: Reduces the tax burden on individuals and families
negative_means: Increases the tax burden on individuals and families

name: Workers & wages
positive_means: Better pay, job security or worker protections
negative_means: Weakens pay, job security or worker protections

name: Small business
positive_means: Lowers barriers, costs or red tape for small firms
negative_means: Adds barriers, costs or red tape for small firms

name: Health care access & cost
positive_means: More coverage or lower costs for patients
negative_means: Less coverage or higher costs for patients

name: Seniors & retirement
positive_means: Strengthens Social Security, Medicare or pensions
negative_means: Weakens Social Security, Medicare or pensions

name: Education & student debt
positive_means: More access to schools and training, or lower student debt
negative_means: Less access to schools and training, or higher student debt

name: Housing affordability
positive_means: Easier to rent or buy a home
negative_means: Harder to rent or buy a home

name: Public safety & crime
positive_means: Reduces crime or supports law enforcement and victims
negative_means: Increases crime risk or weakens law enforcement and victim support

name: Firearms
positive_means: Expands gun owners' rights
negative_means: Adds gun regulation

name: Immigration
positive_means: Tighter enforcement and limits
negative_means: Expanded legal pathways

name: Abortion & reproductive health
positive_means: Expands access
negative_means: Restricts access

name: Environment & climate
positive_means: Cleaner air, water and land, or lower emissions
negative_means: More pollution or emissions, or weaker environmental protection

name: National security & defense
positive_means: Stronger military readiness or homeland security
negative_means: Weaker military readiness or homeland security

name: Veterans & military families
positive_means: Better benefits, care or support
negative_means: Reduced benefits, care or support

name: Privacy & civil liberties
positive_means: Protects speech and privacy, limits surveillance
negative_means: Restricts speech or privacy, expands surveillance

name: Civil rights & equal treatment
positive_means: Stronger anti-discrimination protections
negative_means: Weaker anti-discrimination protections

name: Federal deficit & spending
positive_means: Reduces the deficit or the debt
negative_means: Increases the deficit or the debt

name: Rural & agriculture
positive_means: Helps farmers and rural communities
negative_means: Hurts farmers and rural communities

name: Elections & government accountability
positive_means: More transparency, ethics rules or voting access
negative_means: Less transparency, weaker ethics rules or reduced voting access

name: Energy supply & prices
positive_means: More reliable energy supply or lower energy bills
negative_means: Less reliable energy supply or higher energy bills

name: Infrastructure & transportation
positive_means: Better roads, transit, water systems or broadband
negative_means: Neglects or cuts roads, transit, water systems or broadband

name: Consumer protection
positive_means: Protects people from scams, hidden fees and unsafe products
negative_means: Weakens protections against scams, hidden fees and unsafe products

name: AI & tech
positive_means: Favors innovation and lighter regulation of AI, platforms and tech firms
negative_means: Adds oversight, safety rules or limits on AI, platforms and tech firms
